scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession
Applicant must be a resident of Goa
Applicant must have purchased a Stake Net and its Accessories
Beneficiary can avail of the scheme once every 3 years
Applications are accepted only in offline mode
benefits_summary: Subsidy of 50% up to ₹30,000 for general category and 60% up to ₹36,000 for SC/ST/Women on purchase of stake net and accessories.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
